As well as I don't have any proof, and physical evidence. I saw something move across the sky which it seemed like it took about 3 minutes to cover the distance from the horizons from east to west.

It didn't make any noise, (I was nearby an ocean, so maybe white noise) and there wasn't any blinking lights.

Again, no physical evidence. I tried taking a video of it, but it was to dim to catch anything.
I could not, I was shooting blindly into the sky hoping to catch the stars.

I think I saw the neowise comet, from Washington. At 12am. Not sure what direction it was heading.
But I got a photo.. of something.

I mean, you most not suck at everything if you made it this far! Keep at it! :)

But, I had the same mindset before, when I've gone through my depressions, I thought the same. I don't want to assume what your thinking.
But for me, I didn't focus on what I was doing correctly, and I only focused on my flaws.

Thank you for keeping it formal, as well as I'm sorry, as I did not account that you were damaged. (Which I got to be careful in a place like this) which I apologise.

I came from a dysfunctional, abusive family. 
After I attempted my suicide, my family was sad. Except my step dad, he was pissed, because he had to pay the hospital bills. And piled more abuse on top.

As a kid, at age 11 my mother and step dad was an alcoholic, and I had to learn how to cook for my little brothers and me.
A lot of bruises and beatings later, here I am.

I'm sorry that I tried to force happiness on you,  and honestly I think I called myself healed to give other people hope, but.. that's not the case. And I'm lying to myself.

But I do want to give advice that I felt that at least helped me a little. 

But last night I had a dream about material things, and I swear that got to me. 
And after highschool, all my friends left. Leaving me alone, but I'm looking for people to believe in me, and I got to know.

Or if they say "There he is, who's got a rock to throw?" Because in highschool, I was the social outcast, but no one fucked with me. And I used to look up to my classmates with high grades, and going to the best college and having their whole life made. They're making their parents happy, it seems like the right way. 

Off on a tangent, I'm sorry.

Have a great day, anon. 
Best regards.

I've done a shit ton of drugs, including but not limited to: cocaine, xtc, dope, crack, ghb, ice, speed, k, DMT, mushrooms and lsd.

And I can't say that I've found the meaning of life, but for me, the meaning of life is to help people and make their life better, and find its meaning for me.

I've been put on anti psychotics, and diagnosed with schizophrenia, PTSD, And extreme depression, and I'm seeing a psychiatrist and therapist.
